verdict.rationale: Check gives agents documented access to payroll data. Its hosted and self-hosted MCP server returns payroll details and generates reports in natural language, and its CLI queries payroll data as JSON for scripting. Components also offer a QuickBooks Online integration that points toward ledger sync. However, nothing in the evidence describes a payroll journal or GL-mapped export, or an agent-driven reconciliation of entries into a ledger. missing for 10: an explicit payroll journal or general-ledger entry export/API, documented accounting-sync or reconciliation workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
